newsitem.title: USA: Iomega debuts Zip tools software, drive.
newsitem.headline: Iomega debuts Zip tools software, drive.

text.p: Iomega Corp said on Monday that it introduced a new version of its software suite for Zip drive customers and a new 3-1/2 inch internal version of the SCSI Zip drive.
Iomega's new Zip tools 5.0 software includes a group of applications designed to easily organize, move and protect personal computer information, the company said.
The new software is free until October 31, 1996, to customers via a variety of on-line services, Iomega said.
Iomega said the new Zip drive is available at retailers at an estimated street price of $199.95.
Zip tools 5.0 includes features that make it easier to back up data and easily move programs to Zip Drive disks that would also free up space inside a computers' hard drive, Iomega said.

For $39.95, Iomega said it is offering Zip Tools 5.0 as an upgrade Zip disk, packaged with several Zip accessories, such as a Zip drive carrying case, a Zip disk desk caddie that holds up to six Zip disks, and a Zip-wallet.
